title: Corner Store Thirds
comment:
# Corner Store Thirds

Boom-bap beat, 88 BPM, A minor, 4/4.

## Chords

Am9 → Fmaj7 → Dm9 → E7#9, one bar each, repeating.

## Tracks

| Track | Sound | Part | Mix |
|---|---|---|---|
| Drums | TR-808 kit | Syncopated kick, snare and clap on 2 and 4, swung 8th hats, open hat and ghost snare fills on bars 2 and 4 | Center |
| Bass | Synth Bass 1 | Chord roots with octave pops | Center |
| Rhodes | Electric Piano 1 | Chords held, then re-struck on the and of 3 | Center |
| Percussion | Standard kit | Swung 16th shaker, side stick on the and of 2 and 4, conga and bongo figures alternating by bar | Right, low |
| Strings | String Ensemble 2 | Pad on the upper chord tones (A-C-E, A-C-E, A-C-F, G#-B-D) | Left, quiet |
| Flute (lead) | Flute | The hook | Slightly right, quiet |
| Vibes (harmony) | Vibraphone | Harmony under the hook | Slightly left, quiet |

## Hook

A sparse call-and-response line: E-G-A over Am9, a held E over Fmaj7, F-A over Dm9, and G (the #9) falling to E over E7#9, resolving down to B.

The vibes harmonize below the flute, mostly in thirds, with sixths where a third would clash. Every harmony note is a chord tone, ending on G# under the E7#9 resolution.

## Feel

- **Kick:** on the grid.
- **Snare and clap:** about 17 and 20 ms late, for a lazy backbeat.
- **Hats:** loosest timing (about ±10 ms) and widest velocity range.
- **Bass:** about 8 ms behind the kick, with small timing, length and velocity variation.
- **Hook:** small timing and velocity variation.

## Arrangement

| Section | Bars | What plays |
|---|---|---|
| Intro | 1–4 | Rhodes, strings, shaker |
| Verse | 5–12 | Drums, bass, Rhodes, percussion. No hook, so there's room for vocals. |
| Hook | 13–20 | Everything |
| Break | 21–24 | Hats, shaker, Rhodes, strings, hook. No kick, snare or bass. |

The loop runs bars 5–24, so the intro plays once.

## Transitions

- **Intro → Verse:** snare 16th build, crash on the verse downbeat.
- **Verse → Hook:** half-bar kick-snare-tom fill, bass sits out the last beat, strings swell on E7, crash into the hook.
- **Hook → Break:** the rhythm section stops on the last beat, leaving an open hat ringing.
- **Break → Verse:** 8th-note kicks under a snare roll crescendo, bass walks up E-G#-B into the verse.
